verdicts.title: On tensor rank and commuting matrices
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:

verdicts.title: Estimates for the growth of inverse determinant sums of quasi-orthogonal and number field lattices
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Inverse determinant sums appear naturally as a tool for analyzing performance of space-time codes in Rayleigh fading channels. This work will analyze the growth of inverse determinant sums of a family of quasi-orthogonal codes and will show that the growths are in logarithmic class. This is considerably lower than that of comparable number field codes.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract discusses inverse determinant sums of quasi-orthogonal codes for space-time coding in Rayleigh fading channels, which shares only the term 'quasi-orthogonal' with the conjecture but does not address matrix rank, Boolean functions, or AC0 parity circuit complexity.
